job.value: add optional card attributes to a listing

arrivedFrom.value: the optional-details entry on the TCG form (V3)

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The title 'Optional details' over 'Character', 'Card Number', 'Set', 'Rarity' fields makes the purpose plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Save' is the one action and the most prominent element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Save', the back arrow and 'Choose ›' pickers all do what they say.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Character', 'Rarity', 'Finish' are known to card sellers, but 'Cert Number' has only the placeholder 'Enter' and no hint that it is the grading slab's certificate number.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Most fields are things the seller can read off the card, but 'Cert Number' only applies to graded cards and is asked first regardless.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: This whole page is the tucked-away detail, reached only on demand from the form.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every field is a card attribute for this listing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels with example placeholders ('e.g. 173/165') carry it; no explanatory text.
